Cybercrime is offending mediated by digital systems and shaped by scale, anonymity, automation, platform design, and jurisdictional limits.

## Mechanisms to connect

- low marginal cost of repeated attempts
- anonymity and attribution problems
- social engineering
- cross-border enforcement frictions

## Models to try

- attacker-defender games
- phishing as persuasion
- inspection games with costly monitoring
